title: Cybersecurity Engineer
desc: Sole Security Engineer driving end-to-end security across the entire project portfolio.

groups.label: Azure Cloud Security Engineering
items: Designing and deploying Azure infrastructure for platform and business projects per best practices.
Hardening Azure resources and implementing network security.
Classifying data across Azure resources to enforce backup strategies and security controls.
Developing Bicep IaC with CI/CD pipelines for multi-environment deployments and disaster recovery.
Implementing Azure WAF from scratch and performing ongoing policy tuning.
Acting as an L2 SOC Engineer: developing Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules, investigating incidents, and analyzing logs with KQL.

groups.label: Implementing & Maintaining DevSecOps Practices
items: Automating DAST across the platform using OWASP ZAP and sqlmap.
Enforcing SAST and supply-chain security via GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, Dependabot, Secret Scanning).
Developing GitHub security automations.
Conducting shift-left security assessments.

groups.label: Security Engagements & Governance
items: Designing and implementing ISO 27001 policies, procedures, and EU Cyber Resilience Act compliance controls.
Completing client security assessments.
Leading security awareness meetings and delivering biweekly platform security reports.
Architecting security controls for IIoT devices.

groups.label: On-Premises Infrastructure Architecture & Administration
items: Designing and implementing local Proxmox environment via GitHub Actions CI/CD (Terraform, Ansible, self-hosted runner).
Administering an internal ERP/CRM with SSO integration, automated backups, and hardening.
Building internal LLM platforms (vLLM, llama.cpp, Open WebUI).
Deploying PoC servers (LightRAG, PostHog, ZeroTier) and core infrastructure: SIEM (Wazuh), internal CA (step-ca), and DNS.

groups.label: Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Management
items: Conducting internal penetration tests across Web, API, and IIoT environments.
Coordinating external penetration tests and implementing remediations.
